definition: Household proxy reports illness or injury now or at any time in the last 30 days for a usually resident member. Not a clinical diagnosis or a personally interviewed respondent count.

2004.note: Past four weeks; illness, injury OR other health problem. Includes care-need categories. Do not relabel as 30 days.

2007.note: Unlabelled candidate only. Binary values and downstream blanks do not establish question meaning, period or coding.

2009.note: Printed column (2) matches native q13bc02; no illness-type column in this layout.

2011-12.note: Distributed 2011 form; no separate 2012 verification. Printed (2)/(2a) correspond to native 2a/2b by order, code domain and adjacent illness-type/long-term question checks, not exact printed suffix.

2013.note: Printed (2)/(2a) correspond to native 2a/2b by order, code domain and adjacent illness-type/long-term question checks, not exact printed suffix.

2014.note: Draft with WFP comments, not verified final field instrument. Printed (2)/(2a) vs native 2a/2b resolved by order and adjacent code profiles.

2016.note: Printed (2a)/(2b) matches native suffixes; downstream contradiction flags remain separate from source answers.

2017.note: Native structure and branch profiles resemble 2016; that is not verification of an unchanged health instrument. No health-specific questionnaire transfer applied.

2019.note: Native labels establish Diseases/Injury/No. Truncated question label does not establish reference period/universe; image-based original remains untranscribed. Do not transfer 2021 wording.

2021.note: 1 illness, 2 injury, 3 no. Combine 1 and 2 only for the binary occurrence variable; retain original three-category response.
